body: I am applying for the Accounts Payable / Receivable Accountant role in trivago's Operational Accounting team. I have spent five years in financial operations, most recently at BNP Paribas, where I checked and processed broker invoices every month for BGC/GFI, TP ICAP, Tradition and Bloomberg, reconciled the invoiced fees against internal trade records, and reconciled commission receivables and payables and cash against bank statements. Making sure every invoice is checked and every break is explained is the work I know best.

Your posting asks for someone who reviews as much as prepares, and who improves how AP and AR work end to end. As key checker I reviewed my colleagues' reconciliations and wrote the team's SOPs. I led the automation of our equity reconciliation, building a template that cut handling time from eight hours to four, and introduced auto-matching rules that reduced manual effort by 30%. I already use AI tools in my own work and would like to take that further in a team that is changing how matching and reconciliation are done. I have worked with SAP and will get up to speed on Microsoft D365 quickly.

Hiring me needs no visa support. I already live in Germany and hold a Chancenkarte (§20a AufenthG): a concrete job offer is enough to begin converting it to unrestricted full-time authorisation, and until then the same law permits a two-week full-time trial (details enclosed). My working language is English, trivago's company language, and I am building my German alongside. I can start in Düsseldorf at short notice.
I have attached my CV and a one-page overview of what hiring me involves. I would welcome the chance to discuss the role and am available for the video interview at any time.
enclosures: CV · What hiring me costs you
footer: Chancenkarte holder — eligible for full-time work, no sponsorship required
